name: Recast consented host transformation

input.source: One permission-cleared video, 4–30 seconds, with audio
input.photos: 1–3 consented reference photos including the full body and desired outfit
input.host: Precise description of the person to replace
input.seed: Not supported by the Router model schema

delivery.terminal_error: Check errorType even if status is COMPLETED
delivery.collect: handle.get(); require kind=json, status=completed; read data.video.url
delivery.download: Immediately save and probe the video in private storage

limitations: Genjutsu synthesizes video. Single-person replacement, reference clothing and scene preservation are prompt instructions, not guaranteed controls.
The Router schema exposes no tracked person mask or per-person lock.
Existing outputs are preserved; regeneration creates a new version from the full original, never from a prior crop.
Host-only dubbing is a separate review-and-render stage in host-dialogue.router.json; it replaces selected non-overlapping lines, not lip movements.
preprocessing: Full original video. No fixed crop, box selection or rectangle composite for new jobs.
postprocessing: Download the full provider output. Existing submitted legacy crop jobs retain their historical processing contract.
